title: GitHub parity with Devin: reactions, inline reviews, repo navigation, multi-file commits, issue and PR management, CI visibility
what: The GitHub side acknowledges work like a person, reviews with inline comments and decisions, can navigate and search a repository, commit several files at once, manage issues and pull requests, and read CI results. Merging and deployment stay out of scope.

acceptance.text: Accepted comments get an eyes reaction; the reply swaps it for rocket (answered) or confused (not answered); a refusal that retrying cannot fix gets a warning-style reaction
A pull request review carries a decision (COMMENT, APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES), inline comments on lines and a pinned commit, and the agent can reply in a review thread
The agent can list a directory and search code in a repository
The agent can commit several files, including deletions, to a branch in one commit
The agent can edit an issue (title, body, state, labels, assignees), edit a pull request, add labels and request reviewers
The agent can read check runs, commit statuses and workflow run logs for a pull request head, using a credential scoped to those reads
